lines.text_source: Please don't worry about the roof.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.base_translation: Fica tranquilo com o teto, viu!

lines.text_source: Repairing it won't be too much hassle.
lines.speaker: Balof

lines.text_source: If there's nothing else I can do for you, I shall continue with my duties.
lines.speaker: Brigard
lines.base_translation: Se não houver mais nada, continuarei com meus deveres.
lines.risk_notes: formal military tone must stay clipped and devoid of colloquialisms; 'shall continue' is stiff deliberate choice
